title: Chhotu ke 100 Din · Day 97 · Mistakes ka post-mortem

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Kal unsath percent ne bola B. Akele karo. Toh dekho kya hota.
lines.caps: KAL *59 PERCENT | NE BOLA *B. | AKELE KARO. | TOH DEKHO | KYA HOTA.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Chhotu akela baitha. Wahi galti. Teen baar.

lines.speaker: chhotu
lines.text: Arey ye minus sign kahan se aaya yaar!

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Aur Mishti? Wo Section A mein chali gayi. Bina Chhotu ke.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Par asli kahani mein, Chhotu ne ego side rakha.

lines.speaker: mishti
lines.text: Dikha paper. Ye dekh, minus sign idhar galat hai!

lines.speaker: chhotu
lines.text: Matlab chaar marks bas ek sign ki wajah se gaye?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Raat ko Chhotu ne Zeta pe mistakes wali list dekhi.

lines.speaker: mishti
lines.text: Oye, raat ke gyarah baje padhai? Kaun ho tum?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Agle din retest. Atharah chahiye the.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Section A pakka. Par tabhi Papa ka message aaya.

lines.speaker: papa
lines.text: Sunday ko Nani ke ghar chalna hai. Sab log.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ab bolo. A, Papa ko sach batao. Ya B, bimaari ka bahana banao?
lines.caps: AB BOLO. | *A, PAPA KO | SACH BATAO. | YA *B, BIMAARI | KA BAHANA | BANAO?

choice.question: Papa ko sach batao ya bahana banao?

zeta_placement: Chhotu checks the common-mistakes list on Zeta Galaxy notes at night
story_note: Day 97: (B won 59%, wrong) showed alone-path: same mistake 3x, Mishti in Section A alone. Real path: Mishti spots sign error (4 marks), Zeta mistakes list, retest 19/20, Section A confirmed, Papa says Sunday Nani ke ghar. Q: tell Papa truth (A, correct) or fake illness (B).
